snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Demo OUT NOW | Warhammer Skulls 2026
snippet.description:
Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to
purge!

Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun 2 is coming to PC, PS5 & Xbox Series X|S in 2026.

Wishlist Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 and play the brand new demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115160/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun_2/

See all the Skulls 2026 reveals on Warhammer Community: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/2eknkrto/skulls-2026-the-warhammer-video-games-festival/
